answer: The Translation bundle accepted by the project lead backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the translation bundle is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Like a haven in a workshop, one odd piece hides easily, so the check runs on every submission rather than a sample. Between a ridge and a velvet lies the whole point: Sybils are cheap to mint but expensive to employ.
